description: This file implements the CyclicBuffer class, which manages a circular buffer with thread and process synchronization, supporting operations like read, write, reserve, lock, unlock, and alert. It includes platform-specific synchronization primitives and handles shared memory buffer management.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class providing thread-safe, shared-memory circular buffer operations with synchronization, reservation, and alert mechanisms.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Loads the buffer and initializes internal pointers if not already loaded.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Destroys the buffer and resets internal pointers.

methods.name: AdminLock
methods.description: Locks the buffer's administrative mutex for thread safety.

methods.name: SignalLock
methods.description: Waits for a condition signal with a specified timeout.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available; can be overridden.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Reassesses the buffer's state and signals waiting agents if needed.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: Sets an alert flag and triggers reevaluation.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into a provided buffer, with optional partial read.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer from a provided buffer.

methods.name: AssureFreeSpace
methods.description: Ensures there is enough free space in the buffer for a write operation.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for a future write, returning the size reserved.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Peeks at data in the buffer without removing it.

methods.name: GetOverwriteSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data that can be overwritten, virtual method.

methods.name: GetReadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data that can be read, virtual method.
